verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a design tool, but the evidence documents no native assistant inside Penpot. What is documented is an MCP server for connecting external, user-chosen agents and a community plugin marketplace that includes AI tools. Both are adjacent integration routes, not a first-party assistant you can delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
